title.narrative: Energy Sector Project

description.narrative: Kosovo Compact - Energy Storage Project; the Energy Storage Project aims to support Kosovo's energy security and transition to a cleaner energy future. The project includes supporting battery storage systems that will enable Kosovo's transmission system and market operator to cost-effectively smooth out imbalances in the electricity grid, supporting either a public energy storage entity or an entity created through a public-private partnership to deploy additional energy storage, and strengthening the regulatory environment of energy storage systems, renewable energy projects, and climate change management in a more sustainable and gender inclusive way.

condition.narrative: Before any Disbursement of Program Funding on or after the commencement of year five (5) of the Compact Term, MCA-Kosovo must submit to MCC an initial draft Closure Plan in accordance with the MCC Program Closure Guidelines

Before the first Disbursement of Program Funding for payment under a particular works or construction contract for the Frequency Restoration Response (FRR) Activity, MCA-Kosovo must provide evidence, in form and substance satisfactory to MCC, that all necessary legal requirements for KOSTT (Transmission, System and Market Operator of Kosovo) to acquire ownership of the Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) assets for automated frequency restoration reserves services have been executed and institutional requirements to operate the BESS assets have been defined and adopted

Before the first Disbursement of Program Funding for payment under a particular works or construction contract for the Frequency Restoration Response (FRR) and MultiFunctional Energy Storage (MFES) Activities, the Government shall ensure that KOSTT has developed and implemented all procedures and guidelines necessary to operate BESS equipment on its electricity transmission network, and ERO has undertaken any regulatory requirements and adopted any necessary orders, in form and substance satisfactory to MCC, necessary to incorporate BESS services in Kosovo

Before the first Disbursement of Program Funding for payment under a particular works or construction contract for the MFES Activity, the Government must provide evidence that it has established the MFES Entity, in form and substance satisfactory to MCC, to acquire ownership of the BESS assets for ancillary services and defined all necessary institutional requirements to operate the BESS assets

Before the first Disbursement of Program Funding for payment under a particular works or construction contract for the MFES Activity, the Government shall institute a program providing reduced energy costs or other financial compensation to poor and marginalized communities impacted by higher electricity rates due to the implementation of costreflective tariffs, higher cost energy supplies, or other factors contributing to energy poverty in Kosovo, in form and substance satisfactory to MCC

Before the first Disbursement of Program Funding for payment under a particular works or construction contract for the MFES Activity, the Government shall implement an institutional framework, in form and substance satisfactory to MCC, for Independent Power Producers (�IPPs�) from renewable energy sources that shall include, inter alia: (A) clear institutional roles and responsibilities within the Government for the solicitation, evaluation, engagement, implementation and monitoring of IPPs; (B) a formal process for the open, fair and competitive solicitation of IPPs from renewable energy sources; and (C) the development and publication of standard power purchase agreements.

Before the first Disbursement of Program Funding for payment under a particular works or construction contract for the Multi-Functional Energy Storage Activity, the Government shall release a competitive solicitation for IPPs equal to or exceeding 175 MW nameplate rating, in form and substance satisfactory to MCC, for renewable energy generation project or projects located in Kosovo
Further details on conditions precedent affecting this activity can be found in the top-level parent activities.
